clauses.name: warm

reasons: retrieval passed; serving remains blocked until paired LightGBM NDCG@10 passes
uncertainty_basis: one training run: the supplied tolerances can only have covered evaluation-population sampling (a paired user-level bootstrap). Training stochasticity is unmeasured, so a model whose seeds genuinely disagree is not caught by this verdict, and the warm claim is a single draw rather than a mean. Its uncertainty band is measured on that same population term alone and inherits the same blind spot: it says how far the gain would move on a different sample of users, not on a different training seed.
